title: Activating user actions button should not use this big screen-wide button on overview
symptom: The user action button on the AAPS overview is a big screen-wide button that takes up too much screen space and is easy to hit by accident.
fix: The issue was resolved by a commit that adds an option to manage user actions, likely allowing them to be shown only on the Wear tile or moved to a different location. The commit is referenced as a precedent for managing options for small amounts of users.
evidence_quote: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/df58fe4fa1a04924a479a044c26f5babcd8adda9 Let call this a precedent how to manage options suitable for small amount of users
